title: Information in Society: Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Explain any FIVE issues that were of concern in The Second World Summit on the Knowledge Society, held in September 2009.
Discuss the differences between scholarly information resources and popular information resources.
Explain FIVE benefits of joining a professional association.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS (EACH CARRY 20 MARKS)

parts.text: Discuss some of the factors journalists should observe in order to ensure honest and fair reporting and interpretation of information.
Explain FIVE functions of Kenya National Library Services Board as stipulated in Kenya Library Services Board Act (CAP 225).

items.text: Describe various elements covered by Public Archives and documentation service Act- Cap 19 of the laws of Kenya.

parts.text: Discuss the role the media plays in the society.
Explain FIVE unique characteristics of information.

items.text: Discuss the case for or against freedom of information vs privacy of information in the government of Kenya.
